public_rationale: On April 28, 2026, Bisnow attributed a slowdown since late 2025 and missed revenue targets to Wall Street Journal reporting, but supplied no consistent revenue series measuring growth rates during January–March 2026 [e1]. OpenAI's March 31 disclosure reported current revenue of $2 billion per month, without establishing whether growth slowed during that quarter [e2]. Neither item provides a defined baseline and obligations-and-funding analysis establishing that roughly tenfold growth was necessary by 2030 [e1, e2].
limitations: The slowdown account is secondhand and lacks comparable growth-rate measurements.
Missed targets alone do not establish slowing actual revenue growth.
The evidence does not establish the tenfold baseline, payment schedule, costs or financing assumptions, or independently demonstrate financial deterioration.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's growth is slowing at precisely the time it needs to accelerate, since it needs to effectively 10x its current business by 2030 to meet its obligations, and this is the kind of thing that happens before a company starts dying.

statement.excerpt: This is the kind of thing that happens before a company starts dying. OpenAI’s growth is slowing at precisely the time it needs to accelerate. It needs to effectively 10x its current business by 2030 to make its obligations.

from_speaker: at precisely the time it needs to accelerate
our_interpretation: The central observation concerns slowing business growth at the time of publication. The ordinary financial reading is revenue growth, with user growth as supplementary evidence.
Use January through March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, as the target period. Earlier comparable periods are needed to assess whether growth slowed.
The tenfold statement is a claim about the financial growth requirement understood at publication, not a prediction that OpenAI will actually achieve tenfold growth.
Current business does not specify realized annual revenue, monthly revenue or annualized run rate. No denominator is silently substituted.
To make its obligations describes the purpose of the asserted growth requirement, not a conditional forecast antecedent.
Starts dying is read as financial deterioration, not as a separate forecast with an invented insolvency deadline.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable revenue data show a declining growth rate entering or during the target quarter, and a documented obligations-and-funding analysis establishes that roughly tenfold expansion from the contemporaneous baseline is needed by 2030.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable revenue data establish that the asserted slowdown did not occur, or a sufficiently complete obligations-and-funding analysis disproves the claimed tenfold requirement. Conflicting settled components would warrant mixed.

evidence.explanation: This contemporary report is consistent with the slowdown allegation, but supplies neither a defined revenue measure nor comparable growth rates. Its broad time description cannot be assigned specifically to the target quarter as decisive evidence.
This supplies a company-reported monthly revenue level near publication. A revenue level alone establishes neither acceleration nor deceleration, and is not realized annual revenue.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Consistently defined revenue data through March 2026 and comparable earlier periods, together with a contemporaneous financial model specifying the baseline, obligations, costs and financing needed to test the tenfold requirement.
